mapping.IDENTIFIABILITY_SUPPORTED: IDENTIFIABLE, and a held-out set is NOT_ASSESSABLE
mapping.MODEL_REJECTED: IDENTIFIABLE and a held-out set FAILS for the 1RC
mapping.MODEL_VALIDATION_SUPPORTED: IDENTIFIABLE and every held-out set PASSES for the 1RC
mapping.ledger_rule: an outcome is a report, not a promotion. calibration may PASS only on IDENTIFIABLE; independent_validation stays MISSING with one cell (no cross-cell transfer); measurement_uq is decided by review of the Type B evidence, not by this script

reading.applicability_not_enforced_by_the_route: SOC >= 0.10 is enforced by the role builder only; the route's validity domain does not carry it, so its in_domain does not certify SOC
reading.comparison_note: the constant-current comparison has ONE unit; its interval is degenerate and is a point difference, not a statistical result
hypotheses_not_evidence: slower diffusion beyond one time constant
a capacity-basis offset between the HPPC day and the 1C test day
reading.not_tested: cross-cell transfer (one cell), other temperatures, charge and regenerative drive cycles
reading.rejected: the BUNDLE (this parameter set, the measured OCV, the Q_HPPC charge basis, z0 = 1 and v_p0 = 0) fails the frozen constant-current acceptance on the one 1C capacity test (RMSE 28.7 mV, P95 50.7 mV, bias -25.1 mV). The failure is marginal: 3.65 mV and 0.67 mV over, both below the +/-5 mV voltage accuracy (which is not admitted). The test is in domain only because of the preregistered +/-1 degC widening (case 23.77-25.24 degC against an unwidened 23.56-24.61 degC); without it the outcome would be IDENTIFIABILITY_SUPPORTED. Its initial state (z0 = 1, v_p0 = 0) rests on a 10 s visible rest, a weaker basis than the pulse windows' 590 s
reading.supported: R0, R1, C1 and tau are identifiable from 1C/6C HPPC pulses GIVEN the measured OCV (one cell, 25 degC, SOC >= 0.10). The held-out 2C/4C pulse windows pass the preregistered pooled limits (RMSE 12.5 / P95 27.4 mV), but this tests current interpolation only, shares the OCV knots logged minutes earlier in the same record, is 83 % rest samples, and under load alone the RMSE is 19.7 mV (above 15)
